photos.caption_text: Appendix A 8 1881 (top) and 2005 (bottom) view from the upper Blakiston Valley (elevation 1750 m) east toward Mt. Blakiston, G.M. Dawson, 1881 and Trudi Smith, 2005. Note the extent and severity of the fire, extending into the alpine larch woodland on Mt. Hawkins (upper right), and possibly extinguishing in an avalanche path in the foreground.
